description: Sends a GET with an Origin header (and an OPTIONS preflight for non-simple methods, custom headers or credentials) to a public URL and reports the Access-Control-* headers with an allowed/blocked verdict. Returns { url, finalUrl, origin, status, preflight: { status } | null, headers: { acao, acac, acam, acah, vary }, allowed, issues } Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

credentials.description: Whether the call sends cookies or auth (credentials: include).

method.description: Method the browser call would use; non-simple methods trigger a preflight.

origin.description: Origin the browser would send, e.g. https://app.example.com.

requestHeaders.description: Request header names the call would send (triggers a preflight when non-empty).

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local, metadata and our own hosts are refused.

name: cors-check
title: CORS check
